story.originalTitle: The key to Charles Leclerc overtaking a “quite slow” Lando Norris
story.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc explained that he was able to overtake Lando Norris for second place in the Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix sprint race thanks to different energy deployment strategies.
detailZh: 夏尔·勒克莱尔超越“相当慢的”兰多·诺里斯的关键所在
能量部署在勒克莱尔成功争夺赞德福特F1冲刺赛第二名的过程中至关重要
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利；兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦
夏尔·勒克莱尔解释说，他能够在F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛中超越兰多·诺里斯获得第二名，靠的是不同的能量部署策略。
由于冲刺赛赛制，各车队几乎没有时间微调他们的能量管理设置，在排位赛首轮开始前只有一节自由练习。
勒克莱尔认为，他的迈凯伦对手在主直道上缺乏电量输出，是他在第18圈1号弯得以完成超越、升至第二名的关键因素。
“兰多在主直道上相当慢，”这位法拉利车手说，“他的电量输出不如我。所以我知道在前两圈之后那里会有机会。”
最终，勒克莱尔在比赛结束时将领先诺里斯的差距拉开到四秒，但未能对乔治·拉塞尔构成挑战，在格子旗挥动时落后1.360秒。
当被问及是否认为自己也能超过那辆梅赛德斯时，这位摩纳哥车手回答说：“嗯，我相信有可能。但两三圈之后他开始更加用力地推进，我就知道要超过去会很困难。
“我看到乔治（George）在主直道上采用了不同的能量部署方式，这意味着对我来说想要超车始终会非常困难，即使我已经贴得很近了。”
对于迈凯伦来说，能量管理根本不是他们最担心的问题，因为MCL40赛车在低速弯道中表现挣扎，进而导致轮胎衰减严重——这也是为什么勒克莱尔（Leclerc）尽管使用的是较软的轮胎，诺里斯（Norris）在比赛后段仍未能挡住他的另一个原因。
此外，车手们预计部署策略将会趋于一致，因为各车队会在正式排位赛（届时将进入封闭停车区状态）和正赛之前再次对赛车进行调整。
“在像今年这样有新赛车的年份，这肯定是一个很大的差异化因素，我们今天也看到了。我认为在赞德福特这里几乎不可能超车。如果各车队之间没有不同的功率输出策略，我根本不可能完成那次超车，”勒克莱尔说，他对诺里斯的超越是前15名车手中发生的唯一一次超越。
“不过，到了周日，我们似乎都会趋同到一个比较接近的状态。所以我不指望明天会有很大的差异。
“而且纵观整个赛季，前两三场比赛我们看到到处都有不少缠斗，因为我认为当时大家都不太确定正确的做法是什么。现在，大家似乎又或多或少地趋同了。”
“是的，我想从明天开始大家都会趋同，”冲刺赛冠军乔治·拉塞尔表示赞同。“而且在你获得轮胎优势之前，超车可能会比较困难。”
detailEn: The key to Charles Leclerc overtaking a “quite slow” Lando Norris
Energy deployment was crucial in Leclerc’s successful bid for second place in the Zandvoort F1 sprint
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lando Norris, McLaren
Charles Leclerc explained he was able to overtake Lando Norris for second place in Formula 1’s Dutch Grand Prix sprint race courtesy of different deployment strategies.
Teams had little time to fine-tune their energy management set-ups due to the sprint format, with just one free practice session ahead of the opening round of qualifying.
Leclerc believes his McLaren counterpart’s lack of deployment on the main straight was instrumental in facilitating his move for second place in Turn 1 on lap 18.
“Lando on the main straight was quite slow,” the Ferrari driver said. “He didn't have the deployment that I had. So, I knew there was an opportunity there after the first two laps.”
Leclerc eventually pulled away from Norris by four seconds at the end of the race, but failed to mount a challenge to George Russell, ending up 1.360s down under the chequered flag.

Asked if he thought he could pass the Mercedes too, the Monegasque replied: “Well, I believed in it. But after two or three laps he started to push a little bit more and I knew it was going to be difficult.
“I saw that George had a different kind of deployment on the main straight, which meant that it was always going to be very difficult for me to get past, even if I was getting very close.”

Energy management was the least of McLaren’s worries as the MCL40 struggled in low-speed corners and, consequently, with tyre degradation – another reason why Norris failed to hold off Leclerc late on despite the latter running soft rubber.
Furthermore, drivers are expecting deployment strategies to converge as teams tweak their cars again ahead of the main qualifying session, when parc ferme comes into force, and the race.

“Surely it's a big differentiator on a year like this year with these new cars, and we've seen it today. I think here in Zandvoort it's close to impossible to overtake. And I could have never made the overtake if there wasn't a different deployment strategy between teams,” Leclerc said, with his move on Norris the only pass that occurred in the top 15 positions.
“However, we seem to all converge to a kind of similar place coming Sunday. So I don't expect big differences coming tomorrow.

“And also throughout the season, we've seen the first two, three races, there was a lot of action, a bit everywhere, because I think everybody was not so sure about what was the right thing to do. Now, again, everybody seems to converge more or less in the same place.”
“Yeah, I think everyone's going to converge from tomorrow,” sprint winner George Russell concurred. “And it will probably be a bit challenging to overtake until you get that tyre advantage.”
keyPointsZh: 冲刺赛制下车队在排位赛前只有一次自由练习赛，几乎没有时间微调能量管理设置
勒克莱尔认为诺里斯在能量管理上的不足是其速度较慢的关键
keyPointsEn: Due to the sprint format, teams only had one free practice session before qualifying, leaving little time to fine-tune energy management settings.
Leclerc believed Norris's shortcomings in energy management were key to him being quite slow.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Christian Horner proposes major change to how fans watch F1
relatedItems.summaryEn: Former Red Bull Racing CEO and team principal Christian Horner has suggested that Formula 1 should let fans sit virtually on their favourite team's pitwall and hear how strategy calls are made.
detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳建议对F1车迷的观赛方式做出重大改变
克里斯蒂安·霍纳建议让F1车迷以虚拟方式进入车队指挥台（pitwall），从而更深入地了解比赛策略与决策过程
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及那些让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
前红牛车队首席执行官兼领队克里斯蒂安·霍纳主张，F1应允许车迷以虚拟方式坐进自己支持车队的指挥台（pitwall），听到策略决定是如何做出的。
霍纳在2025年7月离开红牛后，在过去15个月里以车迷身份观看大奖赛，这是他职业生涯中的第一次。
周三在纽约举行的汽车运动商业交流会上发言时，这位英国人表示，维修区指挥台所知与电视观众所见之间的差距令他感到惊讶。
汽车运动商业交流会在纽约市迎来第二届，汇聚了来自赛车运动、商业和品牌领域的高层领袖，地点设在曼哈顿汽车展厅，共同探讨赛车运动在美国的发展。
克里斯蒂安·霍纳自离开甲骨文红牛车队以来首次在美国出席该活动。
其他小组成员还包括七届纳斯卡杯系列赛冠军吉米·约翰逊、前一级方程式董事长兼首席执行官蔡斯·凯里、通用汽车的马克·罗伊斯、潘世奇的乔纳森·吉布森以及纳斯卡的蒂姆·克拉克。
“但对我来说，这也是一种不同的视角。作为一名车迷、一名观众，突然听着我25年都没听过的解说员解说比赛，突然感觉……从维修区墙上那个充满各种信息、知识、策略和对手分析等的茧房里，突然之间你只有屏幕，解说员在解释发生了什么，还有不同的图形，”他说。
“感觉他们本可以揭开更多内幕。车队对此抵制，因为他们不想泄露知识产权和竞争优势。但看看现在观众消费的方式，以及他们对数据和信息的渴望与热切，从我坐在维修区墙上的经历突然变成一名观众，对手分析和策略以及比赛走势的呈现、还有沟通交流，可获取的内容之多令人惊叹。
红牛车队成员在维修区墙上
"显然，这些都在指挥台（pitwall）上进行等等。所以我真的觉得这是一个可以进一步开发的领域，让观众获得更好的体验。"
当被问及如何为车迷实现这一点时，霍纳补充道："也许可以做成互动式的。为什么不虚拟地坐在你最喜欢的车队的指挥台上，了解他们是如何做出决定的、他们正在进行哪些讨论。
"现在，作为一支车队，我会反对这样做，因为你不想把那些信息泄露出去。但归根结底，体育就是娱乐，现在竞争如此激烈，一级方程式已经把自己带到了这个不可思议的位置，当然是通过Netflix系列剧，我们拥有了这一整代新的车迷和不同类型的车迷。
"它必须不断进化。它不能停滞不前，而且它现在处于如此好的位置。它不能原地踏步，我相信它不会，但你必须不断进化。"
detailEn: Christian Horner proposes major change to how fans watch F1
Christian Horner has suggested giving F1 fans virtual access to team pitwalls to offer greater insight into race strategies and decision-making
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Former Red Bull Racing CEO and team principal Christian Horner argued that Formula 1 should let fans sit on their favourite team's pitwall virtually and hear how strategy calls are made.
Horner has spent the past 15 months watching grands prix as a fan for the first time in his career, after leaving Red Bull in July 2025.
Speaking at the Autosport Business Exchange in New York on Wednesday, the Briton said the gap between what the pitwall knows and what TV viewers see had surprised him.

Autosport Business Exchange returned to New York City for its second edition, bringing together senior leaders from across motorsport, business and brands at the Manhattan Motorcars showroom to examine racing's growth in America
Christian Horner made his first U.S. appearance at the event since leaving Oracle Red Bull Racing

Other panellists included seven-time NASCAR Cup Series champion Jimmie Johnson, former chairman and CEO of Formula 1 Chase Carey, General Motors' Mark Reuss, Penske's Jonathan Gibson and NASCAR's Tim Clark

"But for me, it was also a different perspective. As a fan, as a spectator, suddenly watching races with commentators that I hadn't heard for 25 years and suddenly feeling... Going from that sort of cocoon on the pitwall with all that information and knowledge and strategies and competitor analysis and so on, suddenly you've just got the screen with the commentators explaining what's going on and different graphics," he said.

"It felt like there's so much more that they could lift the lid on. The teams fight against it because they don't want to give the IP away and a competitive advantage. But just looking at how viewers consume now and their hunger and eagerness for data and information, going from the experience that I had from sitting on the pitwall to suddenly being a viewer, it's amazing just how much more is available in terms of competitor analysis and strategy and how races are shaping up, and the communication.
Red Bull Racing team members on the pit wall
"Obviously, that's going on on the pitwall and so on. So I really feel that that's an area that could be further exploited to get the viewer an even better experience."

When asked how that could be done for fans, Horner added: "Maybe make it interactive. Why not sit on the pitwall, virtually, of your favourite team, understand how they're getting to the decisions that they are, the discussions that they're having.

"Now, as a team, I would have argued against that because you don't want to be giving that information away. But, at the end of the day, sport is entertainment and there's so much competition now that Formula 1 has got itself into this incredible place where, certainly through the Netflix series, we've got this whole new generation and variants of fans.
"It's got to keep evolving. It can't stagnate and it's in such a great spot. It can't stand still, which I'm sure it's not going to, but you've got to keep evolving."
keyPointsZh: 霍纳是在纽约举行的Autosport Business Exchange活动上发言时提出这一建议的
他提出这一想法，是为了让车迷更深入了解比赛策略与决策过程
keyPointsEn: Horner made the suggestion while speaking at the Autosport Business Exchange in New York
He raised the idea as a way to give fans greater insight into race strategies and decision-making

relatedItems.originalTitle: Franco Colapinto goes viral after surprise Doctor Doom appearance at United States GP
relatedItems.summaryEn: Alpine driver Franco Colapinto appeared at a Williams fan zone event in downtown Austin wearing a Doctor Doom cape and mask, and posed for photos with fans.
detailZh: 弗朗哥·科拉平托在美国大奖赛化身毁灭博士造型后走红
这位阿尔派车手在奥斯汀的一场威廉姆斯活动中给车迷带来惊喜，穿上毁灭博士服装呼应车队的漫威合作
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车不止于运动的故事。
阿尔派车手弗朗哥·科拉平托在威廉姆斯的一场活动中亮相车迷面前，身穿毁灭博士的斗篷并戴上面具。这位阿根廷车手充分利用了本周末的漫威联动，与车迷合影留念。
这位车手在奥斯汀市中心的威廉姆斯车迷区收到了这套服装，当时车队正在那里宣传其与即将上映的电影《复仇者联盟：末日》的合作。
这套服装的视频迅速在社交媒体上传播开来，他的末日博士角色扮演在漫威和一级方程式车迷中走红。威廉姆斯的展示车大受欢迎，格罗夫车队的车迷纷纷涌向国会大道上的活动。在今年早些时候的动漫展活动上成功亮相后，威廉姆斯展示了一款受这部即将上映电影启发的涂装。
车迷区还推出了一本特别版漫画，漫威超级英雄与车手亚历克斯·阿尔本和卡洛斯·塞恩斯一同登场。
《复仇者联盟：末日》定于12月上映，小罗伯特·唐尼饰演末日博士，克里斯·埃文斯和克里斯·海姆斯沃斯以及漫威电影宇宙中众多其他深受喜爱的角色也将加盟。
演员安东尼·麦凯和丹尼·拉米雷斯预计将于周日作为威廉姆斯车队的嘉宾出现在美洲赛道。在第一节练习赛中，阿尔本和塞恩斯身穿超级英雄主题的赛车服，前者穿着雷神主题的设计，而这位西班牙人则穿着美国队长主题的设计。
detailEn: Franco Colapinto goes viral after surprise Doctor Doom appearance at United States GP
The Alpine driver surprised fans at a Williams event in Austin, embracing the team's Marvel collaboration with a Doctor Doom costume
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Alpine driver Franco Colapinto made an appearance in front of fans at a Williams event, donning a Doctor Doom cape and mask. The Argentinian certainly made the most of this weekend's Marvel connection as he posed with fans for photos.
The driver was handed the costume during a Williams fan zone in downtown Austin where the team was promoting its partnership with the upcoming film Avengers: Doomsday.

Videos of the outfit were quickly shared throughout social media with his Doomsday cosplay going viral with Marvel and Formula 1 fans. The Williams show car went down a treat with fans of the Grove outfit flocking to its event on Congress Avenue. After a successful showing at a Comic-Con event earlier this year, Williams showed off a livery inspired by the upcoming film.
The fan zone also featured a special edition comic, featuring Marvel superheroes alongside drivers Alex Albon and Carlos Sainz.

Avengers: Doomsday is due to be released in December, with Robert Downey Jr playing Doctor Doom, joined by Chris Evans and Chris Hemsworth alongside a number of other fan favourites from across the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

Actors Anthony Mackie and Danny Ramirez are expected to be Williams’ guests at the Circuit of the Americas on Sunday. And during FP1, Albon and Sainz wore superhero-themed race suits, with the former wearing a Thord-themed design and the Spaniard wearing a Captain America-themed design.
keyPointsZh: 活动在奥斯汀市中心的威廉姆斯粉丝区举行，威廉姆斯当时正在宣传与漫威电影《复仇者联盟》的合作。
这套毁灭博士服装是在活动现场交给科拉平托的。
keyPointsEn: The event took place at a Williams fan zone in downtown Austin, where the team was promoting its partnership with the upcoming Avengers film.
The Doctor Doom costume was handed to Colapinto during the event.

detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.
